human_artwork_approval.scope: Fresh isolated technical audit without rendering or approval import; existing D decisions remain bound to their own exact bytes

measurement_groups.scope: In-process native measurement reuse, not whole rendering speedup

evidence.overlap: Technical diagnostic counts overlap; fitting proposals and current clipping may describe the same variant

contribution.reason: Anonymous site requires sign-in; component/key mappings unverified

historical_acceptance_contexts.scope: Historical exact sample decisions remain valid in their original contexts. Context differences are not invented runtime stale/rejected/approval events and grant no new approval.
